summary: 오답노트(Lesson) 피드백 루프의 자동화 가능 지점 3개 발견: (1) Lesson 생성 시 ActionPlan 자동 생성 (APOC Trigger), (2) ValidationResult 승인 → Lesson.resolved 자동 갱신 (Cypher Rule), (3) Severity 기반 ntfy 알림 자동화 (Webhook)

automationGaps: Lesson 생성 → ActionPlan 생성: 현재 수동 연결
Severity 기반 알림: am-to-ntfy.py는 Alertmanager만 처리 (KG 이벤트 미지원)

implementableComponents.name: APOC Trigger: LessonCreatedAutoActionPlan
implementableComponents.cypher: CREATE TRIGGER lesson_auto_action AFTER CREATE ON LABEL Lesson SET ap = newInstance.problem + ':' + newInstance.category CREATE (ap:ActionPlan {name: ap, description: newInstance.problem, phase: 'ANALYSIS', priority: newInstance.severity})

implementableComponents.name: ValidationResult → LessonResolved Rule
implementableComponents.cypher: MATCH (vr:ValidationResult {verdict:'APPROVED'})-[:VALIDATES]->(l:Lesson) WHERE l.resolved IS NULL OR l.resolved=false CALL {WITH vr, l SET l.resolved=true, l.resolvedAt=datetime(), l.validatedBy=vr.sourceId} IN TRANSACTIONS OF 10 ROWS

implementableComponents.name: Webhook: Lesson Severity → ntfy.sh Alert
implementableComponents.implementation: extend /03_SCRIPTS/monitoring/am-to-ntfy.py with /lessons route. Map: CRITICAL→urgent+rotating_light, HIGH→high+warning, MEDIUM→default+notepad
dependencies: Lesson webhook schema (POST /lessons/create {lesson_id, name, severity, category})

phase1.name: KG Schema Finalization + APOC Setup
tasks: Standardize Lesson properties (missing constraints on resolved/severity)
Standardize ActionPlan properties (unify phase/status field naming)
Define APOC Trigger (test on 10 dummy Lessons)

phase2.name: Webhook Extension + Alerting
tasks: Define POST schema for Lesson creation events
Integration test: create Lesson → receive ntfy alert

phase3.name: jaebaeman Rule: ValidationResult → Resolved
tasks: Add to Cypher safety whitelist (if needed)

rationale: Lesson 생성 빈도 3~5건/주 × 수동 ActionPlan 작성 10분 = 월 ~2시간 낭비. 자동화로 150% 개선 (0.5시간/월). CRITICAL/HIGH 건의 alert latency 현재 24시간 → 5분으로 단축.

concerns: APOC Trigger 성능 (대량 Lesson 동시 생성 시 bottleneck 가능) → Rate limit or batch
ValidationResult verdict semantics 모호 (APPROVED/FAILED/PENDING 정의 재확인 필요)
Webhook auth (ntfy.sh 토큰 관리, secret rotation 정책 필수)
mitigation: Load test APOC Trigger with 100 concurrent Lesson creates
Document verdict enum values in ActionPlan schema

successMetrics: ValidationResult 승인 후 Lesson.resolved 자동 반영 < 30초
nextSteps: APT SP: 3 component decompose into atomic tasks
APT ST: Contract 정의 (Trigger input/output, Webhook payload schema)
Phase1 시작 전 KG lesson-026-gate-check-validation 참조 (APT Gate Check 자동화 사례)
